name: DC CPU idle capacity
description: Average Processor/Processor Information % Idle Time for _Total over the selected range, rather than counting Perf rows or using an unrelated process counter. Requires collection of this performance counter.
kql:
Perf
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| where ObjectName in ('Processor', 'Processor Information') and CounterName == '% Idle Time' and InstanceName == '_Total'
| summarize Value = avg(CounterValue), Timestamp = max(TimeGenerated) by Series = Computer
| project Timestamp, Series, Value
| order by Value asc
